description: This file defines an abstract class for business events related to fixed deposit accounts within the deposit category. It extends a generic abstract business event class, specifying FixedDepositAccount as the domain model, and provides category and aggregate root ID functionalities.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountBusinessEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing business events for fixed deposit accounts, categorizing them under 'Deposit' and linking to the underlying FixedDepositAccount entity.

methods.name: FixedDepositAccountBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with a FixedDepositAccount instance.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the event, which is 'Deposit'.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated FixedDepositAccount, serving as the aggregate root identifier.
